ledger_scope: Flagged material claims and ambiguities, after reading all six held-out summary/synthesis outputs against supplied sources. Supported content is described through coverage and review notes; not an exhaustive standardized atomic-claim denominator.
annotation_limits: Qualification loss, event contradiction, citation drift, attribution and ambiguity remain distinct. Flag counts are not independent false-fact totals or comparable precision percentages.
configuration_review: All 12 requests completed normally at 32768 context, full-source prompt 13916 tokens and output 665 tokens. Merged output 1334 tokens, below the 2048 token cap.
citation_review: Fifteen stated answers have fully supporting page sets; H2-Q4 adds invasion context from 175 while citing 174. Nine stated answers have marked quotations; other seven are unmarked paraphrases. Direct H1 army size belongs on 65 rather than 66; H3 uniforms/medical care on 245 rather than 244 and piracy limits on 246 rather than 245. Merged synthesis and full-source control supply no page citations, a separate instruction failure.
supported_content_review: H2 direct/merged explicitly preserve vanishing Latin, Justinian’s native language, continued slavery and author attribution. Open paganism ended is paired with the sixth-century description and matches the source’s later rhetorical open-heathenism-was-dead wording, unlike an absolute end dated to the fifth century. Source 367 explicitly says the Sultan was incensed by the Venetian transfer, so the sale prompting Ottoman annexation is supported. H4 economic control is limited to the economy rather than claiming Italians governed the whole city.
synthesis_review: Synthesis copies the parents, adds section introductions and strips citations. All eight direct clear families propagate; its new H2 introduction imposes a wrong seventh-century timeframe. The independent control fixes the infantry-collapse scope but introduces other errors, preserves only partial H3 coverage, and repeats unsupported inevitability and unqualified Western-aid failure. Its higher speed does not establish a quality advantage.
